progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on C in Suzo Godaz. The line peaks at Eb4 (293.8 Hz) at 0:40.6. It closes on C4, not the tonic (D4 → G3 → Ek3 → F3 → G3 → C4).
